item.title: Local restaurants serve free hope and hot plates
item.description: Following Winter Storm Fern, many Oxonians were left without heat or water — and with growling stomachs. item.title: The cost of catastrophe: Effects of Winter Storm Fern linger
item.description: In the early-morning hours of Saturday, Jan. 24, Winter Storm Fern brought freezing rain and sleet to Oxford, closing campus from Saturday, Jan. 24 until Sunday, Feb. 8.
